summary: All requested features tested and verified working. Fixed a backend bug where get_project_name was querying wrong collection (projects instead of pm_projects).

fixed_in_this_iteration.issue: get_project_name function was querying 'projects' collection but project data is stored in 'pm_projects' collection
fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Changed db.projects.find_one to db.pm_projects.find_one on line 89
fixed_in_this_iteration.impact: This was causing linked_project_name to be null in meeting API responses, so clickable project badges were not appearing

details: Schedule Meeting button on Project page navigates to /meetings/new with correct URL params
Meeting Type dropdown shows 'Project: Project Review' (pre-filled from URL type param)
Project dropdown in 'Link to Goals & Projects' section shows 'Marketplace Platform Dev' (pre-filled from URL project_id param)
'in progress' status badge visible on meeting
'Attendance Tracking' badge visible in Participants section header
Attendance dropdown showing 'Present' option for participant
Attendance Summary section showing Present: 1, Late: 0, Absent: 0, Excused: 0
All attendance options (Present, Late, Absent, Excused) available
Project badge with 'Marketplace Platform Dev' text now visible on meeting detail page
Project dropdown loads and shows pre-filled value correctly

seed_data_creation: Created test meetings: TEST_Debug_Payload, TEST_Linked_Project_Debug2, TEST_Linked_Project_Meeting
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed get_project_name function in meetings.py - it was querying wrong collection. All meeting features now working correctly. Attendance tracking works on in_progress meetings. Clickable project/goal/department badges now visible on meeting detail pages when linked items exist.
rca_of_the_issue: The linked project badge was not appearing because the backend's get_project_name helper function in /app/backend/routes/meetings.py was querying the 'projects' collection (db.projects.find_one), but the actual project data is stored in the 'pm_projects' collection. The fix was to change line 89 from 'db.projects' to 'db.pm_projects'.
